attributes.name: Scarab Sand
attributes.powers: Banish this card and bury a card to add 1d12 to a check against a monster by a character at your location. Add another 1d6 if the monster has the Undead trait; if it has the Mummy trait, add another 2d6 instead. If the character fails the check, he may ignore the result and evade the monster.
